y7-001.statement: It is safe to share your school account password with a friend.
y7-001.correction: Keep your password private and ask a trusted adult or teacher if someone requests it.
y7-001.explanation: Passwords protect your account, so even friends should not know them.

y7-003.statement: School email should be used to send personal messages to friends.
y7-003.correction: Use your school email for school-related communication.
y7-003.explanation: School accounts should follow the school's acceptable-use rules.

y7-004.statement: Selecting Hand In submits your completed Microsoft Teams assignment.
y7-004.explanation: Hand In submits it; saving or closing the assignment is not the same.
